title: Dynamic services, fixed 2020–2023 vintage
动态类服务，2020–2023固定版本

source.name: NESO Open Data
source.attribution: Supported by National Energy SO Open Data

notes: CALC-GB-TECH: case-insensitive Battery/Batteries; every other label, NA and blank is other or unlabelled.
Chart-GB-FILL: monthly volume-weighted availability prices; mean cleared MW per EFA block. Pre-EFA daily accepted bids are volume-weighted, represent six blocks and use a separate method.
Historical Delivery Start/End are London wall time, converted to UTC by the source SQL. Masterdata UTC and EAC delivery instants are retained as UTC.
No provider identities, offered-MW line, service maxima sum, requirement series, wholesale price or captured-revenue estimate.

resources.summaryLocator: SELECT "Service" AS service,"Delivery Start" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS t,"Delivery End" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS e,"Cleared Volume" AS mw,"Clearing Price" AS price FROM "888e5029-f786-41d2-bc15-cbfd1d285e96" WHERE "Service" IN ('DCL','DCH','DRL','DRH','DML','DMH')
resources.technologyLocator: SELECT "Service" AS service,"Delivery Start" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS t,"Technology Type" AS technology,"Cancelled" AS cancelled,SUM("Cleared Volume") AS mw FROM "ddc4afde-d2bd-424d-891c-56ad49c13d1a" WHERE "Service" IN ('DCL','DCH','DRL','DRH','DML','DMH') GROUP BY "Service","Delivery Start" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',"Technology Type","Cancelled"

resources.summaryLocator: SELECT "Delivery Start UTC" AS t,"Delivery End UTC" AS e,'DCL' AS service,"Technology Type" AS technology,SUM("Volume Accepted") AS mw,SUM("Volume Accepted"*"Availability Fee") AS cost FROM "0b8dbc3c-e05e-44a4-b855-7dd1aa079c68" WHERE "Volume Accepted">0 GROUP BY "Delivery Start UTC","Delivery End UTC","Technology Type"
